name: VARIANTBIRTH
detailed_description:
【About the game】

◆ Caution ◆

All in-game text has been translated using machine translation.

◆ Story ◆

The betrayal and loneliness that befall the lovely warrior maidens.

Defiled, driven mad, perverted, broken, and then fallen. Into the depths of darkness.

An unfortunate fate befalls the lovely warrior maidens with strong wills!

◆ concept ◆

Check the physical condition of your Valiant Order

with a calendar app-like screen called the Valiant Checker!

The girls' bodies are very delicate and their condition changes every day,

so the intense battle unfolds accordingly!

Dalva, the source of all evil, has conducted a medical check to determine

the physical condition of the Valiant Order

and has unleashed a hideous demon!

When your condition worsens, your mind and body...

[CHARACTER]

●Akari Tachibana●

She is shy, quiet, and unobtrusive.

She has a strong admiration for her older sister, Erika, and aspires to become a xenomorph hunter.

The V-Device she was given is the type Chrysalid.

Her image color is red.

She deploys an absolute field centered on herself.

The deployed force field repels all attacks and does not allow the intrusion of gases, liquids, or even microparticles.

●Sayaka Todo●

When she was a child, she was almost raped by a xenomorph,

She has come to feel aversion to the way males look at her, regardless of whether they are human or deformed.

The V-Device she was given is a typewriter.

His image color is blue.

It disguises the sniper's position by optically penetrating and splitting the sniper's own image.

●Isuka Koga●

Isuka Koga is a hunter of xenomorphs for the sake of her family outside the city.

Because of her strong desire for prosperity, she is aggressive towards others.

The V-Device she was given is a type Lucanid.

Its image color is emerald.

It wears pseudo-gravity on both arms and legs, and crushes the target to death.

●Erika Tachibana●

Erika Tachibana is the head of the school city of Aigis.

She has the authority to command the instructors, make decisions on the management of the school, and negotiate with, accept, and reject governments outside the city.

He is the heart of the school city.

He was once renowned as one of the world's best xenomorph hunters, but retired to train younger generations.

He is now in charge of his current duties.

◆ Game Specifications ◆

・Novel game that progresses with a click

・Heroine fully voiced

・CG mode

・Scene recollection

◆ Content Warning ◆

This work is fiction.

All characters and organizations that appear are fictitious.

It is intended for people over 18 years of age who have sound judgment.

People under 18, those who do not like sexual content,

and those who cannot understand fiction are prohibited from playing.

This game contains the following content

Sex without consent

Extreme play

Hard SM play
